Official Dataset Name: City of Seattle Building Energy Benchmarking Data
Publisher / Authority: City of Seattle Office of Sustainability & Environment
Target Derivation Method: EPA Portfolio Manager utility aggregation (Scope 1 direct gas + Scope 2 electricity)
Leakage Risks: Trivial leakage if direct utility meters (kWh/therms) are included as ML inputs. Resolved by feature separation.
Suitability for Regression & Explainabil: Selected Primary: Coherent urban building sector with 38k+ observations; natural building grouping via OSEBuildingID; enables both accounting baseline and structural ML comparison.

Official Dataset Name: Natural Resources Canada Fuel Consumption Ratings & Vehicle CO2
Target Derivation Method: Calculated directly from laboratory tailpipe dynamometer fuel consumption ratings
Leakage Risks: Target is a direct linear multiple of fuel consumption (L/100km * fuel carbon factor). Approximates a closed chemical formula.
Suitability for Regression & Explainabil: Secondary Candidate: High accuracy but target is purely stoichiometric from fuel consumption.

Official Dataset Name: Open Power System Data (OPSD) Time Series
Target Derivation Method: Aggregated ENTSO-E transmission system operator electricity dispatch
Leakage Risks: Temporal auto-correlation requires strictly sequential forecasting; not building or facility level.
Suitability for Regression & Explainabil: Rejected for Primary: Grid-scale temporal dispatch rather than facility-level emissions accounting.
